summary: Well-executed, fully preregistered paired experiment with complete artifact provenance. The manuscript honestly reports a degenerate ceiling/null outcome (100% success in both conditions) and includes appropriate disclosure and limitations. The study is reproducible from archived artifacts and follows the preregistration. Recommended minor clarifications would improve interpretability but no substantive defects block finalisation.
optional_revisions: Add a very brief per-topology summary sentence or one-line table (edge/core/leaf–spine success counts) in Results to make topology coverage explicit in the main text (artifacts permit this).
Consider adding the exact initial master-prompt text inline or as a short quoted block (the provenance file and SHA are archived; including the prompt in the manuscript would aid reviewers/readers).

Add one concise sentence in Methods clarifying why the bootstrap CI is degenerate (zero width) given no discordant pairs, referencing the archived bootstrap parameters (seed/resamples) already provided.
